app.title: ExamPanel
app.subtitle: School-Year Exam Paper Assignment & Review Automation

common.placeholderNotice: Module is currently in skeleton structure (Phase 1). Business logic will be implemented in upcoming phases.

overview.title: Dashboard Overview
overview.description: Manage and track exam assignment and review panels across the entire academic year.
overview.coreDescription: Verifying IPC communication between UI and the Rust core engine.
overview.scaleInfo: 11 teachers, 4 campuses, 4 exams (GK1, CK1, GK2, CK2) × 3 grades (10, 11, 12) = 12 panels, 36 assignments (24 setters, 12 reviewers).

campuses.title: Campus Management
campuses.description: Manage campuses, codes, color tokens, and active teacher counts.
campuses.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this campus?
campuses.deleteConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone if the campus has no active teachers assigned.
campuses.name: Campus Name
campuses.empty: No campuses found. Please add a new campus.
campuses.campusInUseHint: This campus has active teachers assigned to it. Please reassign or deactivate them before deleting.

teachers.title: Teacher Management
teachers.description: Manage teacher roster, campuses, grades taught, load weights, and active status for the current academic year.
teachers.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this teacher?
teachers.teacherInUseHint: This teacher has linked assignment history. You can deactivate them instead of permanent deletion.
teachers.coverageTitle: Teacher Coverage Matrix by Grade & Campus

onboarding.title: Welcome to ExamPanel
onboarding.subtitle: The system has no campus or teacher data yet. Follow these steps to get started:
onboarding.step1Desc: Define branch locations or campuses in the system
onboarding.step2Desc: Enter teachers, their campuses and grades taught this year
onboarding.step3Desc: Verify hard constraints and solver feasibility
onboarding.step4Desc: Automatically solve, optimize and review panels

exams.title: Exams & Grades
exams.description: Configure 4 standard exam terms (GK1, CK1, GK2, CK2) and grade levels (10, 11, 12).

rules.title: Rules & Constraints
rules.description: Configure 7 hard constraints (H1-H7), 8 soft criteria (S1-S8), and PIN / FORBID locks.

assignments.title: Assignment Plan
assignments.description: Run randomized backtracking and simulated annealing to produce optimal assignment schedules.

stats.title: Statistics & Reports
stats.description: Analyze workload fairness, setter/reviewer distributions, campus rotations, and export reports.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Portable SQLite database path, optimization parameters, and UI preferences.

diagnostics.pinned_teacher_ineligible: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: pinned teacher is not eligible (not teaching grade, unavailable, or inactive)

diagnostics.insufficient_total_capacity: Total maximum capacity across all teachers ({{max_capacity}}) is insufficient for total panel slots ({{total_slots}})
diagnostics.excess_minimum_capacity: Total minimum capacity across all teachers ({{min_capacity}}) exceeds total panel slots ({{total_slots}})
diagnostics.exam_capacity_infeasible: {{exam}}: can satisfy at most {{max_flow}} / {{required}} slots under H4 (max 1 panel per exam)
diagnostics.panel_unfillable_under_h4: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: panel cannot be filled under H4 constraints (reaches {{flow}} / {{required}})
diagnostics.tight_panel_roster: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: available roster has exactly {{count}} teachers (zero redundancy)
diagnostics.teacher_single_panel_eligibility: Teacher {{teacher_name}} is eligible for only {{count}} panel across the whole year
diagnostics.restricted_reviewer_pool: Fewer teachers are eligible to review ({{reviewer_count}}) than total roster ({{teacher_count}})

soft.setter_consecutive: Teacher {{teacher}} is setter in consecutive exams ({{exam1}} and {{exam2}})
soft.grade_not_rotated: Teacher {{teacher}} assigned to only {{assigned}} grade(s) (rotation target: {{target}} grades)
soft.load_deviation: Teacher {{teacher}} assigned {{count}} tasks, deviating {{deviation}} from target quota {{quota}}
